summary: Full802-line original reviewed; fixed lifecycle/injection/TLS/routing/certificate/DNS errors and unsafe generic mitigations; retained all10 troubleshooting topics.
findings: Replaced outdated1.28/contradictory2025–2026date labels with explicit1.31CLI/config review date and link to maintained compatibility guide; no live/prod verification claimed.

Corrected shutdown ordering: ordinary containers have no fixedorder; native initContainer sidecars terminate after app. Drain annotation is not preStop or wait-until-allrequests-complete; 30/60s are examples. Removed nonexistent terminationGracePeriod annotation, unbounded netstat/lifecycle loop, magic unread readiness file and blanket no-app-sleep/minimum60s advice.

Clarified startup-only holdApplicationUntilProxyStarts, new-Pod configuration effects and released1.31 EXIT_ON_ZERO branch that bypasses ordinary drain timer. IstioOperator remains istioctl input, not removed in-cluster controller.

Injection checks both containers/initContainers, intentional ambient no-proxy, webhook/platform/revision selection and Pod-template label vs deprecated annotation. Updated logs to app=istiod. OOM/restart/security-context errors no longer conflated.

Corrected inbound PeerAuthentication vs outbound DestinationRule/auto mTLS, namespaceapp vs root namespace mesh-wide scope, and ambientDISABLE limitation. Removed false diagram asserting clientSTRICT forcesoutboundTLS.
Corrected externalhost→internalService as valid ingress pattern, completed missing hosts/routes/ports/subset config, and explained Service endpoints/labels and gateway-vs-mesh route selection.

Gateway diagnostics cover real Deployment/Service names, IP/hostname, EKS target path and Kubernetes Gateway API status. Valid HTTPS/SIMPLE+HTTP route uses correct gateway reference; certificate existence does not imply client trust and Secret belongs to gateway credential context.

Sidecar is configuration scope, not firewall/ambient policy. Highlatency example no longer adds unsafe blanket retries; complete route uses attempts0 with deadline, actual load/latency diagnosis first.

Removed nonexistent istioctl x ca root and automatic CA-regeneration advice; inspect actual public trustchain, loaded certs, renewal/CA/SDS/clock and supportedrotation. ServiceEntry doesnotrepairDNS; complete startup/readiness probe actions with realappcontract.
Diagnosticcommands namespace-scoped; current-vs-previous logs distinct, Envoy/ztunnel tools distinct, loopbackadmin only and restorecustomloglevels. No assumptions about shell/netstat in proxyimage.

Visually reviewed all3PNG+interactive diagrams perlanguage. Removed wrong/redundant refs0/1/2 with replacement prose: fixedsimultaneousSIGTERM/SIGKILL30s, unconditionalsuccessfuldrain, and clientPeerAuthentication-as-outboundTLS were misleading. Assetfiles unchanged; parent-owned archmap sources need semanticregeneration if reused, not just font recapture.

Follow-up: actualapplication SIGTERM/probecontract, CNI/network path, gateway certificateowner and productionlatency remain deployment-specific; examples are diagnostic guidance and explicitly marked Deploymentmergefragments, not production-testedrecipes.
validation: All802original lines perlanguage read including every codeblock/diagram/reference;6PNGfigures visually inspected.
Perlanguage:5nativekube-inject fixtures verified actualProxyConfig/nativeordering/resourcequantities/probeactions;13Bashblocks syntaxchecked. EN/KO YAML+Bash examples identical.
Native1.31CLI version+10commandhelp probes confirm command/alias availability and absenceofxca. No liveKubernetes/AWScommandexecuted.
